raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Reference out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 interprets density as out-of-plane thickness but does not specify the fully solid reference thickness used in the 2D stiffness calculation.",
      "readings": [
        "Reference thickness t_max = 1 in the domain's length units",
        "Reference thickness t_max = 0.1 in the domain's length units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Restrained boundary or node set",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 2 delegates the boundary setup to unavailable Fig. 1. The initial grid implies a 20-by-10 rectangle, but the restrained portion is not described.",
      "readings": [
        "Restrain the entire left edge",
        "Restrain only the two left corner nodes",
        "Restrain the uppermost and lowermost 10% of the left edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_type",
      "entity": "Displacement components restrained at the supported end",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The 'standard cantilever' label and Fig. 1 caption do not give explicit Dirichlet component conditions.",
      "readings": [
        "Set both horizontal and vertical displacement to zero at every supported node",
        "Set horizontal displacement to zero along the supported edge and fix vertical displacement at one anchor node"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Applied load location",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2 nor the Fig. 1 caption states load coordinates. Let L and H denote the rectangle's horizontal and vertical dimensions.",
      "readings": [
        "Right-edge midpoint: (x/L, y/H) = (1, 0.5)",
        "Upper-right corner: (x/L, y/H) = (1, 1)",
        "Lower-right corner: (x/L, y/H) = (1, 0)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial distribution of the boundary load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Eq. (1) introduces boundary traction, but Sec. 2 supplies no loaded segment, patch width, traction profile, or equivalent nodal-force distribution.",
      "readings": [
        "Concentrated force at one boundary node",
        "Uniform traction over a right-edge patch of length 0.1H centered at midheight",
        "Uniform traction over the entire right edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Direction of the applied load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The load vector is not stated in Sec. 2, Table 1, or the Fig. 1 caption.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward load",
        "Horizontal outward load along the cantilever",
        "Load inclined 45 degrees downward from the outward horizontal direction"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Force or traction amplitude",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The setup is referred to Fig. 1, but no numerical force or traction amplitude appears in the supplied text.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force F = 1 in consistent normalized units",
        "Total resultant force F = 0.001 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Non-design material near supports and loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 does not explicitly state whether all cells are designable or whether support/load regions are held solid.",
      "readings": [
        "All cells are designable; no passive regions",
        "Hold support-incident and load-incident cells at density 1",
        "Hold only load-incident cells at density 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elastic constitutive assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Table 1 gives linear elasticity, E = 1, and μ = 0.3, but does not specify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic plane stress, interpreting μ = 0.3 as Poisson's ratio",
        "Isotropic plane strain, interpreting μ = 0.3 as Poisson's ratio"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Helmholtz filter length convention",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 1 specifies radius 0.375, but no filter equation defines how that radius enters the Helmholtz operator.",
      "readings": [
        "Use filtered_density - 0.375^2 × Laplacian(filtered_density) = raw_density",
        "Convert a nominal radius to Helmholtz length 0.375/(2√3), and use its square as the Laplacian coefficient"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE filter boundary conditions",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 names a Helmholtz-type PDE filter without specifying boundary conditions or exterior-density treatment.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous Neumann conditions on the entire domain boundary",
        "Zero filtered density on the entire domain boundary",
        "Extend the filter domain with exterior cells fixed to zero density"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PDE filter discretization and transfer to element densities",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text does not specify filter unknown locations, interpolation order, mass-matrix treatment, or how the filtered field becomes an element density.",
      "readings": [
        "Continuous bilinear nodal filter with a consistent mass matrix and cell-average output",
        "Continuous bilinear nodal filter with a lumped mass matrix and centroid-sampled output",
        "Cell-centered finite-difference Helmholtz filter with one output value per cell"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Volume accounting after density filtering",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (1) writes the volume constraint using ρ, while the PDE filter is introduced separately without a filtered-variable version of that constraint. Later sections distinguish raw and filtered densities.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain the volume of raw design densities while using filtered densities for stiffness",
        "Constrain the volume of filtered physical densities and use those densities for stiffness"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "GOCM exponential update and step-length interpretation",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Table 1 provides the optimizer name, exponential update label, and step schedule, but no update equation, gradient normalization, or independent move-limit definition.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a multiplicative OC ratio update, with the scheduled step length as its exponent",
        "Use an exponential-of-gradient multiplicative update, with the scheduled step length multiplying the gradient",
        "Use an exponential update with the scheduled step length limiting the absolute density change per iteration"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Meaning of element density change in the stopping criterion",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (2) averages Δρ_e, but the accompanying sentence does not define whether this element change is signed or absolute.",
      "readings": [
        "Δρ_e = |ρ_e(new) - ρ_e(old)|; stop when its volume-weighted mean is below 10^-4",
        "Δρ_e = ρ_e(new) - ρ_e(old); stop when the absolute volume-weighted signed mean is below 10^-4"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finest element size",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 2 prints h4 = 1 × 0.5^4 = 0.06125. The formula actually gives 0.0625, also consistent with Remark 1's 320-by-160 grid over the inferred 20-by-10 domain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use h4 = 0.0625, following binary refinement and the stated fixed-grid dimensions",
        "Use h4 = 0.06125, taking the printed decimal literally"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Displacement finite elements and integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2 gives cell counts and sizes, but no displacement interpolation order or stiffness quadrature rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with 2-by-2 Gauss integration",
        "Nine-node biquadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
